element_inventory: Opening Range definition: first 5-minute candle 09:30-09:35 NY time; capture high, low, and midpoint
Breakout condition: candle body closes completely outside the range (full close, not a wick or touch)
Retest condition: candle opens outside range, wick dips inside range, close back outside range
Retest invalidation/occurrence-selection: if the candle closes inside the range the signal is invalid â€” wait for the next candle
Entry timing: enter on the open of the next candle after the valid retest
Stop loss placed at the range midpoint
Risk per trade: 1% of deposit (fixed position-sizing rule; percentage-of-deposit or fixed lot configurable)
Execution constraint: all decisions made on closed candles only (no intra-candle / look-ahead reads)
strategies.entry_summary: Opening Range = the first 5-minute candle from 09:30 to 09:35 New York time; mark its high, low, and midpoint. Wait for a valid breakout: a candle whose body closes completely outside the range (a full close, not a wick or touch). Then wait for a valid retest: a candle that opens outside the range, wicks back inside, and closes outside again (if it closes inside the range the signal is invalid and you wait for the next candle). Enter on the open of the next candle after the retest. All decisions are made on closed candles only.
strategies.exit_summary: Stop loss at the range midpoint; take profit at a 2:1 reward-to-risk ratio.
